contract: NATIVE_GRAMMAR_DELEGATED: transmit the exact one-line command; native Tern owns argument validation and operation semantics. Mapping does not establish successful effects.

critical_notes.run: Only writes and briefly settles; not command completion.
critical_notes.resize: Endpoint means window dimensions; scenario means pane direction. Never translate one into the other.
critical_notes.dump/tree/webreports: Raw selector consumes remainder. Do not script-quote or append comments.
critical_notes.css: Bare = list; name = drop; name+path = replace. Native parser cannot take spaces in these fields.
critical_notes.carly tool/lua: Errors can be stored as last_tool.error with an ok script reply. Follow carly ok and correlate the answer.
critical_notes.plugin list: Filesystem Ready or host Ready does not prove window entry loaded.
critical_notes.plugin install/remove/link/unlink: Exit zero can accompany reload problems on stderr.
critical_notes.melt: Even progress zero closes the session.
critical_notes.file wait / notebook wait / sqlite: Work settled is not a successful load/query/code result.
critical_notes.shot/serve: Headless settings and screen are synthetic; no plugins unless fixture loading; not live-fleet proof.
critical_notes.quit/close: May await confirmations; acknowledgement is not closure.
critical_notes.remote state/setup: Can simulate connection/setup rather than establish a real one. Never auto-trust a staged fingerprint.
